caption: The drawing shows a bonnet that is colored predominantly in purple, with a texture suggesting woven or stitched material. The edge of the bonnet is bordered with intricate, dark purple lace trim that runs along the front and the lower edge. At the base of the bonnet, near the neck area, there is a large, light pink ribbon tied into a bow, with trailing ends. On the right side of the bonnet, there are clusters of pink roses with green leaves, arranged as decorative embellishments on the crown of the bonnet. The background is plain and uncolored. The artist’s signature, “FLORENCE EARL,” appears in small letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Hat
